pieces.Text: Once per day a salt mephit can draw the moisture from an area in a 20-foot radius centered on itself. Living creatures within range take 2d8 points of damage (Fortitude DC 14 half; caster level 6th). This effect is especially devastating to plant and aquatic creatures, which take a -2 penalty on their saving throws. This ability is the equivalent of a 2nd-level spell.
